page.overview:
Who is Armas Drugada?

was an actress who worked with Halandil Fang, and for whom Wicander Halovar felt a romantic attachment..}}

Wicander met Armas through their mutual connection Halandil Fang, when she was an actress in Hal's troupe and Wicander was taking lessons from him. Wicander attended her performances and (according to Tyranny) spent the following hours praying a lot. According to Wick part of their connection was due to the nature of theater itself, and he denied that she was his girlfriend, although they "felt a bit of a connection". Wicander kept a portrait of her in his room, which was one of the few things he took with him when he ran away from his family. Following their first mission together, Wicander told Tyranny that he was feeling vulnerable around her, and it made him really realize that he missed Armas very much, and he should search for her.

Armas had gone missing at about the same time Wicander's family arranged his betrothal to wealthy heiress Ebecca D'Antonio..}} His family was aware of the relationship as a romance, and Yanessa described the girl as "the one who got away", when reminding her grandson that he would have to marry Ebecca anyway.
